sentences.text:
---
 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY  ---
 For the Petitioner : Mr. R. S. Mazumdar, Sr. Advocate  & Mr. Prateek Sen, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Arun Kumar Pandey, APP  ---
 Order No. 07 Dated 18th November, 2016 Mr. R. S. Mazumdar, learned senior counsel, appearing for the petitioner submits that the report of the Food Analyst along with the sample on the request of the petitioner was sent to the Referral Food Safety Laboratory, Mysore for further test but the report suggest that the sample was not in condition fit for further analysis. It has also been submits that valuable right of the petitioner under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 has been extinguished in view of the fact that the sample sent by the Food Analyst was not found fit for further analysis.

It has also been submitted that two persons of the Department had taken the sample and in the case in which Burfi was taken for testing one of them Gulab Lakra, Food, Safety Officer, Ranchi became complainant.

It has also been submitted that on the same day at the same hotel premises of the petitioner, the food article namely Paneer was also seized by the Food Safety Officer and proceeding was initiated before the Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi which vide order dated 13.08.2014 the same was dropped, as the samples were not sealed in presence of independent witnesses as per provisions of Food Safety Standard Act, 2006.

It has also been submitted that the complainant of C-III Case No. 254 of 2013,
which has been lodged with respect to Burfi, was the witness in Food Safety & Standards Case No.
43 of 2013-14 initiated with respect to Paneer.

entities.text:
Food Safety & Standards Case No.
43 of 2013-14
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Learned counsel further submits that contradictory reports submitted by two different labs i.e. by the State Food Analyst and the Referral Lab, Mysore,
suggests that the department has not been able to establish case against the petitioner beyond doubt.
Mr. Arun Kumar Pandey, learned APP prays for and is allowed four weeks' time to seek instruction and file counter affidavit.
Until further orders, further proceedings in connection with C-III Case No. 254 of 2013, pending before the Court of learned ACJM, Ranchi, shall remain stayed.
Let a copy of this order be handed over to Mr. Arun Kumar Pandey, learned APP.
